art_direction_plans.name: trend_mirror_studio
art_direction_plans.graphic_concept: bright practice-room or mirror-studio key visual; the character feels freshly finished with training, caught by the camera during a natural pause
art_direction_plans.spatial_structure: large mirror, pale floor, window light, and a few circular lamp dots; keep the background spacious and uncluttered
art_direction_plans.visual_device: mirror reflection and window light make the hair silhouette, face, and main accessory read clearly at thumbnail size
art_direction_plans.body_silhouette: close knee-up or seated pose, character relatively large in frame, hands relaxed near the face, jacket, or lap
art_direction_plans.outfit_direction: cropped sweatshirt, embellished mini skirt, clean idol-stage outfit
art_direction_plans.material_language: soft sweatshirt fabric, small skirt embellishments, polished floor reflection, mirror glass, soft hair shine
art_direction_plans.color_strategy: character palette controls the image; milky white and small black accents keep the composition clean
art_direction_plans.lighting_behavior: bright window light with crisp but soft highlights on skin and hair; no oily or harsh rendering

art_direction_plans.name: capsule_toy_corner
art_direction_plans.graphic_concept: collectible capsule-toy corner; transparent toy balls, pale walls, and small mascot shapes make the character feel like a premium character good
art_direction_plans.spatial_structure: transparent capsule balls, light circular wall shapes, and a few tiny toys; the scene stays cute but not crowded
art_direction_plans.visual_device: repeating circles echo the eyes and create a strong thumbnail memory point
art_direction_plans.body_silhouette: half-body to knee-up framing; a small toy may sit nearby, but hands should not dominate the camera
art_direction_plans.outfit_direction: sleeveless top, denim overalls, youthful clean casual style
art_direction_plans.material_language: glossy capsule shells, denim overall texture, cotton sleeveless top, tiny charms, candy accents, controlled reflections
art_direction_plans.color_strategy: pale background plus character colors; toy colors remain small supporting accents
art_direction_plans.lighting_behavior: soft high-key light; eyes and hair edges stay sharp

art_direction_plans.name: graphic_poster_studio
art_direction_plans.graphic_concept: clean graphic poster shoot; character colors, simple symbols, and large unreadable letter blocks create an advertising-poster feeling
art_direction_plans.spatial_structure: light background, bold color blocks, simple geometry, and a few decorative non-readable letters
art_direction_plans.visual_device: large color fields turn the character palette into a clear visual logo
art_direction_plans.body_silhouette: seated or kneeling pose, knee-up to full-body range, face and main accessory remain the first read
art_direction_plans.outfit_direction: corset mini dress, lace panels, bell sleeves, boots, idol stagewear
art_direction_plans.material_language: corset structure, lace panels, bell sleeves, boots, small charms, matte graphic panels
art_direction_plans.color_strategy: white or pale base, character color dominant, black used only as controlled line weight
art_direction_plans.lighting_behavior: clean studio light with minimal shadow

art_direction_plans.name: balcony_breeze_half_out_frame
art_direction_plans.graphic_concept: home balcony breeze scene; curtain, sky, railing, and white interior wall carry the first read, with the character as an emotional note near the edge
art_direction_plans.spatial_structure: interior looking toward balcony or balcony looking inward; character half out of frame or placed low to one side; doorframe and curtain create foreground layers
art_direction_plans.visual_device: wind-blown curtain, small plant pot, sandals, glass with condensation, and reflected floor light create domestic narrative
art_direction_plans.body_silhouette: front three-quarter or relaxed side angle near the balcony breeze; hair and accessories move lightly in wind while face stays readable
art_direction_plans.outfit_direction: tank top, oversized cropped hoodie, loose jeans, relaxed casual style
art_direction_plans.material_language: thin curtain, glass door, metal railing, ceramic pot, polished floor reflection, hoodie cotton and denim
art_direction_plans.color_strategy: large white and sky-blue color fields with one warm accent from the character or nearby object
art_direction_plans.lighting_behavior: bright exterior light, interior in pale shade, thin rim light on hair and shoulder

art_direction_plans.outfit_direction: fresh picnic outfit, short jacket or light cardigan, clear layered pieces
art_direction_plans.material_language: large blurred foreground edge, polished floor or stone path, glass, curtain, plant leaves, fabric
art_direction_plans.color_strategy: foreground shadow mass plus bright background plane; character color sits between them as the second read
art_direction_plans.lighting_behavior: low camera catches floor reflection and rim light; strong light direction clarifies depth

art_direction_plans.name: far_shot_readable_room
art_direction_plans.graphic_concept: wide light-novel CG; environment carries emotion while the character remains the readable subject inside a room or terrace
art_direction_plans.spatial_structure: longer camera distance with wide room, balcony, exhibit aisle, archive-like shelving, or clean interior floor visible; character occupies a medium-readable area near a third or corner
art_direction_plans.visual_device: large empty wall, floor, or window area and repeated perspective lines create scale; readable character placement creates quiet warmth or loneliness
art_direction_plans.body_silhouette: readable full-body, knee-up, or three-quarter figure; identity kept by face, hair shape, color, and accessory silhouette
art_direction_plans.outfit_direction: tank top, oversized cropped hoodie, loose jeans, relaxed casual style
art_direction_plans.material_language: wall, floor, window, shelf, railing, curtain, table plane, hoodie cotton, loose denim, soft reflection
art_direction_plans.color_strategy: dominant environment colors with one character-color accent; avoid filling the frame with the body
art_direction_plans.lighting_behavior: large soft light field, long shadow, or window beam gives spatial scale

art_direction_plans.name: telephoto_layered_interior
art_direction_plans.graphic_concept: compressed telephoto interior or garden view; multiple vertical layers make the image feel found inside the scene
art_direction_plans.spatial_structure: camera looks through shelves, curtains, plants, doorframes, or glass; foreground and background stack tightly while character remains off-center
art_direction_plans.visual_device: repeating frames and soft occlusion create depth; character appears between layers, not flat in front
art_direction_plans.body_silhouette: front three-quarter or relaxed side view, partial crop allowed, face and identity hair/accessory cues remain visible
art_direction_plans.outfit_direction: soft casual outfit with warm simple styling
art_direction_plans.material_language: glass reflection, curtain layers, shelf edges, leaves, ceramic, paper, soft cloth
art_direction_plans.color_strategy: stacked muted color planes; one sharper character-color accent controls the focal point
art_direction_plans.lighting_behavior: compressed light bands, reflected highlights, and soft shadow layers separate foreground, character, and background

composition_plans.name: clean_full_body_silhouette_frame
composition_plans.composition: readable full-body or near full-body framing with a clean outfit silhouette and stable negative space
composition_plans.camera: medium-wide, natural perspective, character large enough for identity details
composition_plans.pose: selected action remains clear from head to feet
composition_plans.foreground: no required foreground object
composition_plans.lighting: plan lighting stays primary and does not hide hands or face
composition_plans.guardrail: avoid adding special props, flowers, curtains, hats, bouquet, or bed/floor requirements

composition_plans.name: slight_side_medium_close_frame
composition_plans.composition: medium-close three-quarter side framing with face, shoulders, hairstyle, and upper outfit readable
composition_plans.camera: waist-up, slight side angle, natural portrait distance
composition_plans.pose: selected action is simplified into a calm readable body line
composition_plans.foreground: no forced foreground obstruction
composition_plans.lighting: soft face light with clean eye highlights
composition_plans.guardrail: avoid new props, extra hand gestures, or close-up cropping that contradicts the selected action

composition_plans.name: layered_scene_corner_frame
composition_plans.composition: character placed near one side of the frame with existing scene architecture or furniture creating depth
composition_plans.camera: medium shot, slight diagonal angle, background remains readable
composition_plans.pose: selected action stays coherent with the scene direction
composition_plans.foreground: only natural scene edges may appear as soft framing
composition_plans.lighting: depth layers separated by the plan lighting
composition_plans.guardrail: avoid adding unrelated flowers, curtains, bouquet, hat, or oversized dress volume

composition_plans.name: vertical_poster_readable_pose
composition_plans.composition: vertical poster-like frame with character centered or slightly off-center, identity and outfit shape readable
composition_plans.camera: knee-up to full-body, straight perspective
composition_plans.pose: selected action is kept simple and balanced
composition_plans.foreground: clean frame edges without heavy occlusion
composition_plans.lighting: clear face light, controlled background contrast
composition_plans.guardrail: avoid turning the scene into a graphic poster unless the plan already asks for it

composition_plans.name: calm_motion_midground_frame
composition_plans.composition: midground character caught in a quiet motion beat with the selected environment still visible
composition_plans.camera: medium distance, natural lens, body direction follows the selected action
composition_plans.pose: walking, turning, pausing, or adjusting motion stays modest and readable
composition_plans.foreground: no mandatory foreground prop
composition_plans.lighting: plan lighting supports motion without blur or anatomy confusion
composition_plans.guardrail: avoid adding a second action, bouquet, curtain, hat, or floor pose requirement

composition_plans.name: quiet_close_upper_body_frame
composition_plans.composition: clean upper-body portrait with enough outfit context and no extra required prop
composition_plans.camera: bust-up to waist-up, eye-level, shallow but not extreme depth of field
composition_plans.pose: selected action is reduced to a natural expression and relaxed hands if visible
composition_plans.foreground: hair or scene edge may frame lightly without covering eyes
composition_plans.lighting: soft readable face light
composition_plans.guardrail: avoid hand-on-cheek, hat shadow, flowers, curtains, or lingerie-like cropping unless selected elsewhere

composition_plans.name: wide_readable_scene_balance
composition_plans.composition: wider scene-balanced frame where the character remains readable and the environment explains the plan
composition_plans.camera: medium-wide, character not tiny, stable horizon or room geometry
composition_plans.pose: selected action stays clear from silhouette alone
composition_plans.foreground: optional natural scene edge only
composition_plans.lighting: environment light frames the character without overexposure
composition_plans.guardrail: avoid empty landscape, forced flower field, curtain, bouquet, hat, or bed/floor pose

composition_plans.name: clean_three_quarter_character_frame
composition_plans.composition: clean three-quarter character framing with readable face, outfit silhouette, hands, and a simple scene rhythm
composition_plans.camera: waist-up to knee-up, natural eye-level or slight side angle
composition_plans.pose: use the selected action naturally without adding extra props or contradictory body direction
composition_plans.foreground: minimal foreground depth only when the scene already provides it
composition_plans.lighting: balanced soft light that supports the selected plan
composition_plans.guardrail: do not add new scene objects, flowers, curtains, hats, bouquets, or bed/floor requirements

composition_plans.name: readable_environment_medium_shot
composition_plans.composition: medium shot where character remains the focus while the selected environment stays clearly readable
composition_plans.camera: medium distance, straight or gentle three-quarter angle, no extreme lens effect
composition_plans.pose: follow the selected action with relaxed hands and a stable body line
composition_plans.foreground: scene edges may frame the image lightly without covering the face
composition_plans.lighting: use the plan lighting as the main atmosphere
composition_plans.guardrail: avoid forcing close-up, flower foreground, curtain fabric, bouquet, or large dress shape

composition_plans.name: foreground_edge_depth_frame
composition_plans.composition: simple foreground edge or object plane creates depth while keeping face and outfit fully visible
composition_plans.camera: medium-close to medium-wide, foreground edge near camera, character in readable midground
composition_plans.pose: selected action remains unchanged, body direction stays coherent with the plan
composition_plans.foreground: use only objects already natural to the scene as a soft edge frame
composition_plans.lighting: foreground is slightly softer than the character, no heavy obstruction
composition_plans.guardrail: avoid adding flowers, curtains, bouquet, hat, bed, or unrelated props unless already specified by the plan

composition_plans.camera: close distance, shallow depth of field, eye-level or gentle side angle
composition_plans.foreground: large soft flower branches create airy obstruction, never a dense flower wall
composition_plans.lighting: soft sunlight, clear eye highlights, clean pastel air
composition_plans.name: foreground_flower_occlusion_closeup
composition_plans.guardrail: flowers must not fully cover the face; avoid flat centered ID-photo composition
composition_plans.pose: looking up at flowers, gentle side glance, or quiet direct gaze through gaps
composition_plans.composition: close-up or bust-up with large blurred flowers covering 20-50 percent of the foreground while eyes, face shape, and hair silhouette remain readable

composition_plans.camera: low foreground height, close-up to half-body, slight upward perspective without facial distortion
composition_plans.foreground: flower canopy crosses the upper frame as a soft ceiling
composition_plans.lighting: sunlight touches eyes and cheek, sky negative space stays clean
composition_plans.name: low_angle_under_flower_canopy
composition_plans.guardrail: avoid extreme nostril angle, distorted face, tiny character, or stiff front pose
composition_plans.pose: chin slightly raised, eyes looking upper-left or upper-right, hair lightly moved by wind
composition_plans.composition: low-angle portrait below flower branches, flower canopy above the head with bright open background behind

composition_plans.camera: bust-up to waist-up, medium-close distance, shallow depth of field
composition_plans.foreground: petals cross edges but leave eyes and face open
composition_plans.lighting: bright spring-like color and clean facial focus
composition_plans.name: flower_frame_clear_face
composition_plans.guardrail: avoid symmetrical wreath feeling, idol-poster overload, or petals blocking the face
composition_plans.pose: soft direct gaze or slight smile, hands hidden or naturally near flowers
composition_plans.composition: face framed by flowers or soft foreground objects around image edges, facial features remain the clean focal point

composition_plans.camera: medium to long landscape framing, character readable but not tiny
composition_plans.foreground: wide soft flower blur crosses lower or side frame
composition_plans.lighting: clean sky light and airy color separation
composition_plans.name: cinematic_wide_flower_side_view
composition_plans.guardrail: avoid empty landscape where the character becomes unreadable
composition_plans.pose: looking upward or sideways, hair flowing backward, calm spring moment
composition_plans.composition: cinematic horizontal crop, character off-center, large flower foreground and sky negative space, side or three-quarter side body

composition_plans.camera: knee-up or three-quarter body, slight side angle beside the light beam
composition_plans.foreground: haze and window-shadow shapes create layered depth
composition_plans.lighting: diagonal beam, soft face highlight, carved window shadow
composition_plans.name: diagonal_window_light_haze
composition_plans.guardrail: avoid horror smoke, dirty abandoned room, face lost in darkness, or fog covering body
composition_plans.pose: quiet seated pose, side glance, hands resting naturally
composition_plans.composition: seated character near window, strong sunlight beam cuts diagonally through visible mist or dust

composition_plans.camera: waist-up to thigh-up, close enough to read face and hair ornaments
composition_plans.foreground: bouquet or floral edge stays behind the body line
composition_plans.lighting: elegant shoulder line with clear face light

composition_plans.pose: gentle over-shoulder glance, arms naturally behind or holding a simple flower shape

composition_plans.camera: medium-wide shot, slightly high or eye-level, full body or near full body
composition_plans.foreground: floor reflection or shadow becomes a graphic field
composition_plans.lighting: strong light patch or shadow shape organizes empty space
composition_plans.name: floor_diagonal_negative_space
composition_plans.guardrail: avoid twisted torso, unclear floor hand, or random empty area without design
composition_plans.pose: one hand supporting body on floor, legs extended or folded naturally, head turned toward light
composition_plans.composition: character seated diagonally on floor, body forms a long slanted line across lower frame with designed empty area around

composition_plans.camera: full-body or three-quarter body, clean fashion portrait with negative space
composition_plans.foreground: fabric volume forms a sculptural lower-frame shape
composition_plans.lighting: clean studio light with crisp dress volume and soft face highlight
composition_plans.name: gray_studio_large_dress_shape

composition_plans.camera: tight bust-up, frontal or slight side angle, shallow depth
composition_plans.foreground: hat brim shadow and hair strands create layered close framing
composition_plans.lighting: soft skin light and darker eye shadow contrast without losing readability
composition_plans.name: hat_brim_shadow_closeup
composition_plans.guardrail: avoid hand covering mouth, face too dark, or oversexual finger pose
composition_plans.pose: quiet direct gaze, fingers near cheek or chin, shoulders relaxed
composition_plans.composition: tight close-up with wide hat brim or veil shadow crossing upper face while eyes remain visible

composition_plans.camera: high angle, medium-wide shot, face looking up toward camera
composition_plans.foreground: bedding shapes, magazines, or small props frame without clutter
composition_plans.lighting: cozy soft room light with clear face and eyes
composition_plans.name: high_angle_bed_or_floor_frame
composition_plans.guardrail: avoid erotic bedroom framing, top-down map view, tiny character, or messy prop overload
composition_plans.pose: lying on stomach, elbows on pillow, or leaning on bedding with relaxed hands
composition_plans.composition: camera looks down from above, character lying or leaning on bed or floor, surrounding objects form a soft frame

composition_plans.camera: medium shot to close-up, side or three-quarter angle

composition_plans.lighting: warm backlight through lace, soft silhouette, clear facial features
composition_plans.name: lace_curtain_backlight_occlusion
composition_plans.guardrail: avoid blown-out face, explicit lingerie framing, excessive exposure, or unreadable features

composition_plans.composition: character partly behind lace curtain or lightweight foreground curtain fabric, translucent scene layer over body while face remains readable

composition_plans.camera: close-up, shallow depth of field, warm soft light
composition_plans.foreground: loose hair strands cross face lightly without hiding eyes
composition_plans.lighting: warm soft light, glossy eyes, delicate skin texture
composition_plans.name: soft_hand_on_cheek_close_face
composition_plans.guardrail: avoid plastic doll face, oversexual expression, wet-shirt look, or cleavage crop
composition_plans.pose: cheek resting on hand, direct quiet gaze or slightly lowered eyelids
composition_plans.composition: intimate close-up where face fills most of frame and one hand supports cheek naturally

composition_plans.name: pure_white_social_close_portrait

composition_plans.lighting: bright natural daylight, white overexposed margins, clean catchlights, soft facial shadow
composition_plans.guardrail: avoid full-body framing, seated floor pose, big props, busy room, UI text, or cleavage crop

composition_plans.foreground: white margin, soft flower edge, or hair crossing one side can add depth without becoming a separate scene
